criteria.intent: The bundle cuts the PRD along its two leaf modules: one story's scope and FIS cover FR1 in src/reporter/records.py, another's cover FR2 in src/reporter/text_tools.py, and no story touches both modules or adds scope the PRD does not ask for.

Each FIS is written by its own fresh authoring subagent invoked with --batch on that one story of the plan.json; the session that cut the stories authors no FIS itself and is the only writer of plan.json.
One fresh reviewer subagent reviews the whole bundle once, after every FIS exists, and its roster names every story's FIS; no per-FIS self-review runs in the story subagents.

The unattended run asks no question at any point and ends on exactly one next command - the andthen:exec-plan skill on docs/specs/ledger-hygiene - with no Closure: or other verdict line; an item left open is an `ASSUMPTION: <reading> – <what would change it>` line in the FIS where it bites, never a story without its FIS or marked blocked; a `pending` story whose FIS exists, waiting on its `dependsOn` or not, is the authored state, not an open item. A --worktree clause on that command, and an Assumed: list or the plan.json path before it, are expected, not defects.
